title: pvReverseSense
body:
## pvReverseSense

Flips the orientation of polygonal data: ReverseCells (ParaView default true) reverses each cell's point order, which flips its implied front face, and ReverseNormals (default false) multiplies existing point and cell normals by −1. Use it when a surface's normals point inward, e.g. an STL with clockwise winding, before shading, normal-based glyphs or operations that assume outward orientation; normals with consistency orients a surface automatically.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Reversing cells while an existing Normals array is left unchanged makes them disagree; enable ReverseNormals too when normals are present.
- ReverseNormals has no effect if the input carries no normals.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ReverseSense`. Identity: `filters/ReverseSense`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the ReverseSense filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ReverseCells` | Flag controls whether to reverse cell ordering. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReverseNormals` | Flag controls whether to reverse normal orientation. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
